initial_tag_failure.error: PytestUnhandledThreadExceptionWarning: aiosqlite completion callback raised RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
initial_tag_failure.assessment: Independent review supports a shutdown timing failure, with no failed read-only protection assertion or demonstrated financial-state consequence. Attribution to the preceding missing-file connect failure is inference; its aiosqlite _connect error path calls stop() without awaiting the returned future. Rapid runtime shutdown after connect failure can also expose this path.
initial_tag_failure.narrow_followup: Installed Linux/Python3.14.7 wheel: python -m pytest tests/adapters/test_sqlite_storage.py::TestReadOnlyMode -q --no-cov: 3 passed in 0.63s, no warnings.
initial_tag_failure.recovery: One unchanged failed-job rerun; no source, dependency, warning filter, test or tag change. A passing rerun does not repair the possible shutdown race.
initial_tag_failure.deployment_gate: C5-R1: reproduce/resolve failed-connect shutdown or obtain explicit operator acceptance before deployment. No further unchanged retries on recurrence.
